planets.name: HAT-P-70 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-70 with a 2.74-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HAT-P-70 b crosses its star every 2.74 days and is 1.9 times as wide as Jupiter, found in 2019.
text.introduction: HAT-P-70 b transits HAT-P-70 every 2.74 days and is 1.9 times as wide as Jupiter. Orbit and size follow Zhou et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ZHOU_ET_AL__2019): pl_orbper 2.74432452, pl_radj 1.87, pl_bmassj 6.78
